column1: # The HB recipe (goat_elegant: Z9X HB G0130 / G0148, MT9660, 32-bit userspace, Android 13 vendor with VNDK 33):

# and the T*_NOTES.md; the build host runs it as the normal user with sudo for the loop mounts and the root copy.
# Flags: t1 (the bare first-boot image), test (tN), pub (x.y.z[-betaN|-rcN], the public release), usbadb, rel,
# diagopt, otatest, dsutest; derived lumen (every image but t1), diag (diagopt or t1), info (LumenInfo: not in the
# the click volume file and the audio policy file, each against the pinned HB vendor file of the stock dump here
# the Google add-on: the Z9X boot side unchanged (the bytes the Z9X gate recorded), the HB allow-list of arm zips
# MediaTek's VNDK libstagefright_foundation.so (hb_media.rc): the stock HB system copy of the dump here, pinned

column1: # the install from a DSU try: every trigger needs ro.gsid.image_running=1, the props carry ro.lumen.dsu_install=1
# the public release: the unchanged Z9X blobs reader binds the user's own copies (blobs_allow.txt names them)
# the OTA client: gate files, HB gate data and props, bootctl, otacerts, updater
# ---- the base: the pinned Play 6 LineageOS 21 gsi_tv_arm userdebug build (patches 0001-0006, 2026-10-24)
# 0a. the base's own boot image and system_server odex are the soong dexpreopt_arm output of this build
# 1. APEX modules uncompressed (apexd would unpack every .capex during post-fs-data, late for the PWM watchdog)
# 1b. rule S1: the base's platform set, the four APEXes with a platform APK and mac_permissions, signed on the Mac
# 2. debloat (the shared GSI list, the HB lines, the launcher in the Lumen images); TvProvision stays in t1 (it provisions the device there), the Lumen images drop it
# 3. added files: owner root, labels from the file contexts at mkfs time (5)
#   3a. XGIMI's vendor apps hidden before the package scan
#   3b. the fastbootd escape (every image), the USB-stick boot logger (--diag only)
#   3c. network adb on the stick variant only
# Lumen Setup is HOME on wiped data; the projector app is the persistent system-uid app, no HbBoot
#   t10: MediaTek's VNDK copy for codec2 (test images); the public release binds the user's own copy instead
#   Bluetooth: the base's libbluetooth_jni.so with SBC at 44.1 kHz, bound over the APEX copy (hb_bt.rc)
#   3e. the public image: the OTA client

column3: ota: gate, bootctl {BC_SHA}, otacerts.zip, LumenUpdater and update_verifier.rc installed (channel {ota_channel})

column1: # 3z. --dsu-test: network adb during a DSU try with the build host's adb PUBLIC key

# 6. the image against the base: every entry, only the debloat, APEXes, added files and props may differ
